latest.title: Z-Deck 0.2.56-cyberdeck
latest.notes: Makes dual-mesh selection strictly manual. Z-Deck stays active while using maps, chats, settings, GPS, OTA, SD, and diagnostics; area advice never switches firmware. MeshCore also stays active until its explicit Z-DECK return action is confirmed. The dual USB installer preserves NVS, LittleFS, SD files, channels, keys, and local preferences.
